name: forward-app-theme-carry-uninterpretable
description: FORWARD tolerance on the theme CARRY read (ggui#1175, VERSION-POLICY §3.6): a theme GET response for a stored document that fails the carry shape, as a door that names it returns it — `theme: null` beside `uninterpretable`, whose issues carry a path and a protocol-owned code and never a stored value. Today's response schema must accept it, and must read it as a document that is not a theme, never as "no theme".

release.label: a later ggui release (synthetic): the theme GET naming an uninterpretable stored document
